name: Discord
overview: Scripture condemns discord as a serious offense against God and community, highlighting that sowing discord among brethren is an abomination to the Lord (Proverbs 6:19). Bearing false witness and speaking lies not only harm others but also defile the speaker, reflecting the condition of the heart (Exodus 20:16; Matthew 15:18). Believers are called to love their neighbors without grudges or revenge, embodying God's holiness and hatred of iniquity (Leviticus 19:18; Psalms 5:5). Thus, discord arises from sinful speech and attitudes that God expressly hates, urging His people to pursue unity and truth.
